# workflow contract

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-contract-docs.js from packages/development/toolchain/categories/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract version: `1.0`

The `workflow` category defines 11 capabilities: 5 required and 6 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workflow.branch-create` | required | yes | `name`, `baseBranch` | `name` | - | - | Create a new branch following the configured branching strategy. |
| `workflow.sync` | optional | yes | `branch` | `branch`, `ahead`, `behind` | - | - | Sync the current branch with its parent/trunk. |
| `workflow.propose` | required | yes | `headBranch`, `baseBranch`, `title` | `id`, `url` | - | - | Propose the current branch for integration (open a change request / submit for review). |
| `workflow.ship` | optional | yes | `branch` | `branch`, `status` | - | - | Ship (land/merge) a proposed branch per the configured branching strategy. |
| `workflow.status` | required | no | `scope` | `clean`, `files` | - | - | Report the working tree's clean/dirty state and changed files. |
| `workflow.commit` | required | yes | `message` | `sha` | - | - | Commit staged changes with the given message. |
| `workflow.push` | required | yes | `branch` | `branch` | - | - | Push the current branch to its remote. |
| `workflow.log` | optional | no | `ref`, `limit` | `commits` | - | - | Read commit log entries, optionally scoped to a ref and bounded by a limit. |
| `workflow.diff` | optional | no | `ref` | `text` | - | - | Read a diff against a ref. |
| `workflow.merge-base` | optional | no | `refA`, `refB` | `sha` | - | - | Find the common ancestor commit of two refs. |
| `workflow.remote-url` | optional | no | `remote` | `url` | - | - | Read the URL of a configured remote. |

## Details

### workflow.branch-create

Create a new branch following the configured branching strategy.

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `name`, `baseBranch`
- Outputs: `name`
- Fallback: none

### workflow.sync

Sync the current branch with its parent/trunk.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `branch`
- Outputs: `branch`, `ahead`, `behind`
- Fallback: none

### workflow.propose

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `headBranch`, `baseBranch`, `title`
- Outputs: `id`, `url`
- Fallback: none

### workflow.ship

Ship (land/merge) a proposed branch per the configured branching strategy.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `branch`
- Outputs: `branch`, `status`
- Fallback: none

### workflow.status

Report the working tree's clean/dirty state and changed files.

- Fallback: none

### workflow.commit

Commit staged changes with the given message.

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `message`
- Outputs: `sha`
- Fallback: none

### workflow.push

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `branch`

- Fallback: none

### workflow.log

- Inputs: `ref`, `limit`

- Fallback: none
